open_points.subject: sandbox scratch bound
open_points.text: “one private exchange directory bounded by `sandbox_scratch_bytes_max`” contradicts “The scratch total is measured once, when the environment has ended … the files the parent put there excluded … and a file removed before the end is not counted.”
open_points.question: Does `sandbox_scratch_bytes_max` bound the exchange directory throughout execution, or only the qualifying files that remain when execution ends?
options: Bound qualifying files only at the end
Bound the entire exchange directory throughout execution
open_points.default_guess: Treat only qualifying files remaining at the end as the scratch total, because that is the newer and more specific rule.

open_points.subject: scratch-total measurement
open_points.text: “The scratch total is measured once, when the environment has ended”
open_points.question: What execution outcome and process behavior apply if the parent cannot enumerate or stat the exchange directory well enough to compute the scratch total?
options: Record `crashed` with `cleanup_failed` and stop the kernel
open_points.default_guess: Record `crashed`; use `cleanup_failed` and stop the kernel only if subsequent directory removal also cannot be confirmed.
